title: Phase 02 Profile Claim Policy

p02_mapping.canonical_gate: Phase 02 measurable exit gate: existing-profile claim meets the approved assurance policy and never returns candidate existence to the client

non_claims: This artifact records Controller-frozen Policy v1 decisions. It is not APPROVED_PRODUCTION_POLICY.
This artifact does not reuse or inherit Product, Security, or Privacy approval from the Profile-Correction policy.
This artifact does not copy Product/Privacy/Security approver identities from another policy as if they approved Profile Claim.
This artifact is not G-08-04 independent human security/privacy approval.
This artifact does not close P02-AUDIT-005.

model.name: HYBRID_PROFILE_CLAIM
model.high_confidence: future self-service attach when the full PC-002 proof bundle and eligibility rules are satisfied
model.otherwise: internal Manual Review using the existing non-enumerating client contract

decisions.title: claimant_eligibility
decisions.policy_decision: Only AccountType Patient with AccountStatus Active may start a Profile Claim ceremony.
decisions.rationale: Pending, suspended, locked, and closed accounts must not start claim. External contract stays hidden or generic.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Ceremony must reuse Patient plus Active gates. Do not implement the ceremony in the policy-recording task.

decisions.title: high_confidence_proof_bundle
decisions.policy_decision: High-confidence self-service requires National ID HMAC match to one Active unlinked profile, matchesBoundIdentity, a consumed profile_claim OTP on the already-verified phone, and a valid clinic-issued claim credential for that exact profile. DOB, full name, gender, blood type, other NID-derived demographics, National ID plus OTP alone, and patient verification-document upload are not independent additional proof.
decisions.rationale: ADR 0011: National ID plus a newly verified phone is insufficient. Card demographics are not possession of the walk-in record. The additional factor is the clinic-issued profile-bound credential.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Future ceremony must enforce the full bundle before attachAccount.

decisions.title: assurance_states
decisions.policy_decision: Successful high-confidence self-service bind records ial2_verified_link. Manual-review pending records ial2_proof_pending. Operator bind after Separation-of-Duties review records ial3_operator.
decisions.rationale: Aligns with ADR 0011 assurance vocabulary.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Future attach and operator paths must persist these values. This artifact does not authorize operator workflow implementation.

decisions.title: fresh_otp_required
decisions.policy_decision: A new profile_claim OTP on the already-verified phone is required. A pre-existing AAL1 session alone is insufficient.
decisions.rationale: Step-up for the ceremony, not entitlement from a long-lived device session.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Wire purpose-bound OTP into the future attach ceremony.

decisions.title: account_status
decisions.policy_decision: Only AccountStatus Active. No self-service claim for pending_phone, suspended, locked, or closed. Do not expose sensitive eligibility information.
decisions.rationale: Same non-disclosing denial envelope already used for pending business routes.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Keep hidden NOT_FOUND or generic pending as applicable; do not add eligibility oracles.

decisions.title: self_service_profile_eligibility
decisions.policy_decision: Self-service requires profile status Active and user_id IS NULL. Anything else routes to internal Manual Review with the generic external pending contract.
decisions.rationale: Unlinked Active walk-in rows are the only high-confidence target class.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: findClaimCandidate already returns only unlinked Active rows; attach remains unused.

decisions.title: already_bound_profile
decisions.policy_decision: No self-reclaim, no overwrite, no automatic reassignment. Existing user_id remains unchanged. Route internally to Manual Review where appropriate. Do not disclose that the profile is already bound.
decisions.rationale: Prevents account takeover of an owned profile.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Unique user_id and collision pending already prevent overwrite; ceremony must preserve that.

decisions.title: one_user_one_profile
decisions.policy_decision: One user maps to one patient profile. Preserve patient_profiles_user_id_unique. No v1 change to 1:1 ownership.
decisions.rationale: Caregiver, guardian, and proxy models remain Phase 01 non-goals.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Keep the partial unique index. Ceremony must not create a second linked row for a user.

decisions.title: one_profile_one_user
decisions.policy_decision: One authoritative patient profile maps to one user. Preserve authoritative National-ID-HMAC uniqueness where status <> merged. No proxy or shared-profile model in Policy v1.
decisions.rationale: Duplicate active identities are a takeover and integrity failure.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Keep patient_profiles_authoritative_hmac_unique.

decisions.title: credential_attempt_budget
decisions.policy_decision: Failed credential attempts are budgeted by account plus NID-HMAC: 5 per hour then 15-minute cooldown; 15 per 24 hours then internal Manual Review lock. External response remains generic. Do not expose attempt count or credential existence, correctness, expiry, or reuse.
decisions.rationale: Brute-force resistance without an enumeration oracle.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Implement counters only in the future ceremony task.

decisions.title: rate_limits
decisions.policy_decision: Ceremony starts: 5 per account per hour, 20 per IP per hour, 5 per NID-HMAC per hour. OTP: 6 digits, 300 second TTL, 5 verification attempts, 60 second resend, 5 per phone-HMAC per hour, 20 per IP per hour, 200 global per hour.
decisions.rationale: Reuse the existing OTP abuse budget and add claim-specific ceremony-start keys.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: OTP numeric values already exist in identity config. Claim ceremony-start limiters are not implemented.

decisions.title: non_enumeration
decisions.policy_decision: The client must not learn NID existence, link state, credential state, disputed/restricted/archived state, or that a rate-limit or risk rule caused review. Do not introduce wrong_claim_code, profile_exists, profile_already_linked, claim_code_expired, or national_id_not_found. Use manual_review_required or existing hidden NOT_FOUND.
decisions.rationale: G-01-22 and ADR 0011 non-disclosure.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Current collision and disabled-OTP envelopes are generic. Future ceremony must not add oracles.

decisions.title: otp_is_part_of_attach_ceremony
decisions.policy_decision: profile_claim OTP is part of the future attach ceremony: issue, verify, consume, then attach only when the remaining PC-002 bundle is valid. There must be no successful profile_claim OTP path that means a completed claim without the credential and bind.
decisions.rationale: The purpose enum must not become a dangling OTP without attach semantics.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: VerifyOtpService currently has no ProfileClaim attach branch. Do not wire it in the policy-recording task.

decisions.title: hybrid_routing
decisions.policy_decision: All high-confidence requirements satisfied: eligible for future self-service attach. Anything missing, invalid, expired, reused, ambiguous, rate-limited, risk-flagged, or ineligible: Manual Review. Client response remains generic.
decisions.rationale: Hybrid model selected by the Controller.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Implement routing in the future ceremony behind the disabled flag.

decisions.title: dispute_and_wrong_bind
decisions.policy_decision: Wrong bind or ownership dispute freezes the affected profile using status disputed, which already exists on patient_profiles. Authorized operator review is required. No automatic reassignment or transfer.
decisions.rationale: Schema already includes disputed. This artifact does not invent a status and does not implement the freeze workflow.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Map freeze writes to PatientStatus::Disputed in a later implementation task.

decisions.title: notifications
decisions.policy_decision: Notify on successful profile bind, failed-proof lockout, and dispute freeze. Notification content must not contain National ID, phone number, claim credential, or other secret proof material.
decisions.rationale: Phase 02 named linked-account notifications; privacy forbids proof leakage.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Future notification service work. Not this task.

decisions.title: observability_before_enablement
decisions.policy_decision: Metrics, alerts, dashboard visibility, and monitored rollout or cohorts are required before PC-020 production enablement.
decisions.rationale: Canonical Phase 02 rollout: enable claim separately with monitored cohorts and a kill switch.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: clinic_profile_claims_total exists but is unused in production. Alerts and dashboards are absent. Do not implement them in this task.

decisions.title: incident_runbook
decisions.policy_decision: A dedicated Profile Claim incident/runbook is required before production enablement. The stale statement that the patient identity registry is unavailable must eventually be corrected. This task does not edit the runbook.
decisions.rationale: docs/runbooks/disputed-profile-link.md still describes a Phase 01 stub registry.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Correct and expand the runbook in a later evidence/implementation task.

decisions.title: kill_switch_preserves_valid_links
decisions.policy_decision: Disabling Profile Claim stops new claims. It does not automatically unlink already-established valid account/profile links. Dispute and recovery are separate.
decisions.rationale: Canonical Phase 02 rollback preserves submitted profiles and links.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Current kill switch is global hard-off with no live claim binds. Future disable must not un-bind.

decisions.title: production_remains_hard_off
decisions.policy_decision: Production remains hard-off. This artifact is not permission to enable production, set FEATURE_IDENTITY_PROFILE_CLAIM=true, or remove APP_ENV=production hard-off. Enablement requires recorded policy, implementation, tests, observability, governance approvals, independent QA, and applicable independent human gates in a later separately authorized change.
decisions.rationale: Silent env enablement is an accepted ADR 0011 residual that production force-off currently blocks.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Keep PlatformFeatures production short-circuit unchanged in this task.

decisions.title: otp_recency_step_up
decisions.policy_decision: The profile_claim OTP must have been successfully consumed within 10 minutes of attach. AAL1 session alone is insufficient. Patient TOTP is not required by Policy v1.
decisions.rationale: Recent possession of the verified phone at bind time.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Enforce recency in the future attach transaction.

decisions.title: post_enablement_env_kill_switch
decisions.policy_decision: After a separately authorized PC-020 change exists, FEATURE_IDENTITY_PROFILE_CLAIM=false must disable new claims without a code change. Process or config reload may be required. Current production is already hard-off. Do not alter current behavior in this task.
decisions.rationale: Fast operational disable after the hard-off is intentionally removed.
decisions.implementation_evidence_requirement: Today the production short-circuit ignores the env flag. Do not remove it here.

P02-AUDIT-005.note: Controller Policy v1 is recorded. Ceremony is not implemented. Production remains disabled. This is not closure.
